doc: route_bench.py results, 2026-11-16. fast = fastscene scenes of detector 2ef0018e4 + cached U-Net probs d0 (validation set simulated unmapped); oracle = OSM objects with the spec noise (15 % greens / 30 % tee complexes dropped, false greens / tees, 20 % fairways dropped); clean = OSM objects without noise. Router v0 = zero_tap/joint solve.py (model_osm), v1 = solve2.py (model_scene, V1_PARAMS). Scoring routing.score; courses without a web card are included and routed with no card (hole_acc counts a course without a result as 0 holes right).
